title: Bundle of Holding: Knock! Magazine Bundle
summary: Three full issues of the KNOCK! tabletop RPG magazine (about 650 pages of system-neutral adventures, tools and ideas) as DRM-free PDFs for one flat price, about a quarter of retail.
notes: Single flat price, no tiers. Ends Tue 2026-10-20 07:59 EDT per the page countdown. Ends in 4 days, so show it soon or drop it.

title: Bundle of Holding: Cthulhu Awakens
summary: The complete Cthulhu Awakens core rulebook (a Mythos RPG built on the AGE system) plus the Revelations of the Bacchae scenario for $12.95; paying over $21.22 adds a bonus set of six more titles including Cults of the Mythos and Fantasy AGE Cthulhu Mythos.
notes: Two tiers: starter $12.95 (retail $53), bonus collection unlocked above $21.22 (total retail $121). Ends Tue 2026-10-27 07:59 EDT per the page countdown.

title: Bundle of Holding: Blue Fox Cthulhu
summary: Nine Blue Fox Mythos titles for $17.95: three Cthulhu gamebooks plus graphic novels based on Lovecraft stories, so it suits Cthulhu fans who like solo and story-driven reading.
notes: Mostly gamebooks and graphic novels, not RPG rulebooks, so borderline for a tabletop RPG site. Single flat price. Ends Thu 2026-10-29 07:59 EDT per the page countdown.

title: Bundle of Holding: Monster Hunters of the Week Bundle
summary: The Monster of the Week 2023 Revised core rulebook plus the Slayer's Survival Kit and Hunter's Journal for $14.95; paying over $29.28 adds five more books including Codex of Worlds and Tome of Mysteries.
notes: Two tiers: Hunter Collection $14.95 (retail $60), Keeper Collection unlocked above $29.28 (total retail $127). Ends Tue 2026-11-03 06:59 EST per the page countdown.
